_about: Static reference for every Sims 4 world: its identity across the mods that name worlds differently, and its place on the map. Nothing here is generated - it is stable game knowledge, so it is committed rather than extracted.
_geography_source: Positions describe the in-game world map as rendered by Simmatically's Immersive World Map, which lays all worlds out as one connected geography instead of unrelated tiles. Landmass grouping and adjacency were dictated by the user from that map on 2026-08-14.

_key_systems.home_regions_code: Kuttoe Home Regions identifier, used in <World>_Worlds allow-lists. SCREAMING_SNAKE of the config key prefix.
_key_systems.basemental_legalization: BmdBuffs.Legalization member. Cannabis and gambling legality are PER WORLD - one flag each, no sub-world scope. null means Basemental has no legalization flag for that world.
_key_systems.config_prefix: Kuttoe Home Regions config key prefix, e.g. <prefix>_Worlds / <prefix>_Soft.

north.label: North continent
north.adjacency_notes: Innisgreen - Britechester - HenfordOnBagley run west to east. Henford connects on to Nordhaven (north, mountainous) with Windenburg below it. ForgottenHollow sits right of Nordhaven, Ravenwood right of Hollow, Tartosa right of Windenburg.

east_islands.label: East islands
east_islands.adjacency_notes: MtKomorebi north with the large mountain, Tomarang below it. Sulani is an island south of those, GibbiPoint an island below Sulani, Ondarion to Gibbi's left.

west.label: West continent
west.adjacency_notes: Glimmerbrook sits above EvergreenHarbour, before MoonwoodMill. Evergreen - Moonwood - GraniteFalls run across the north. Copperdale is caddy-corner below Moonwood/Granite with BrindletonBay to its right. Newcrest below Copperdale, SanMyshuno right of Newcrest, WillowCreek caddy-corner to both, MagnoliaPromenade right of Willow. Strangerville below Willow, OasisSprings the desert left of Strangerville, DelSolValley below the desert, SanSequoia the peninsula between Evergreen and DelSol. ChestnutRidge right and below Strangerville, CiudadEnamorada below Chestnut, Selvadorada right of Ciudad.

detached.label: Not on any landmass
detached.adjacency_notes: Batuu appears on the travel map as a portal off to the side, in the clouds - not connected to any continent.

Innisgreen.notes: Ireland/Celtic. Fairy Council sits in Everdew; gnome worship on the coast.

Britechester.notes: University world - Foxbury and UBrite. NOT legalizable in Basemental.

Nordhaven.notes: Scandinavian, plus Amsterdam and Camden Market. Iverstad is repurposed industrial; Gammelvik historic canals. Small business and hobby meetups.

Windenburg.notes: Club culture - Partihaus, Paragons. Von Haunt Estate.

ForgottenHollow.notes: Vlad's world. Perpetual night, 5 lots, no civic institutions.

Ravenwood.notes: Romanian medieval inspiration; death, afterlife and the Netherworld.

Tartosa.notes: Italian coastal wedding destination. Has NO Home Regions TouristsToggle.

Tomarang.notes: Southeast Asia - Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Vietnam. Morensong bustles and hosts the Night Market; Koh Sahpa is quiet. Landlord/tenant world. Has NO TouristsToggle.

GibbiPoint.notes: Outdoor adventure - geysers, waterfalls, firewatch towers, old mines.

Ondarion.notes: Mediterranean - Italy, France, Morocco. Little premade lore found; confirm with the user before leaning on it.

Glimmerbrook.notes: Spellcasters. Portal to the Magic Realm; Caster's Alley sells potions openly - an established legal intoxicant economy.

EvergreenHarbour.notes: Home of Neighborhood Action Plans - the world where Maxis put civic voting.

MoonwoodMill.notes: Werewolf packs - Moonwood Collective and Wildfangs. Post-industrial, no institutions.

GraniteFalls.notes: National park, campgrounds, the Hermit. No residents. NOT legalizable in Basemental.

Copperdale.notes: Teen and high-school world. Prom, PTA energy.

BrindletonBay.notes: Nautical New England. Deadgrass Isle is the run-down quarter.

Newcrest.notes: Deliberately empty - no premades, no lore. The sandbox world.

SanMyshuno.notes: Dense city. Festivals, activism, the Politician career - Maxis put politics here.

WillowCreek.notes: Southern-genteel suburb. Home of the Goths and the Pancakes.

MagnoliaPromenade.notes: Retail only - 4 lots, zero residents. Built to hold shops.

Strangerville.notes: Military base, the Mother, government secrecy.

DelSolValley.notes: Hollywood. Fame and Reputation systems - Mirage Park is the run-down end.

ChestnutRidge.notes: Ranching, horses, and NECTAR MAKING - an established, celebrated home-brewed intoxicant.

CiudadEnamorada.notes: Mexico City inspired. Romance, love hotels, nightlife.

Selvadorada.notes: NOT legalizable, but Basemental ships a SELVADORADA_DEALER trait - modelled as a source, not a jurisdiction.

Batuu.notes: Reached by portal, not travel. No TouristsToggle in Home Regions.

Glimmerbrook_MagicRealm.notes: Hidden. Paired with Glimmerbrook in Home Regions defaults.

SylvanGlade.notes: Secret lot reached from Willow Creek.

ForgottenGrotto.notes: Secret lot reached from Oasis Springs.
